title: Embedded & IoT Developer
description: A roadmap for building connected devices with electronics basics, microcontrollers, firmware, sensors, protocols, and cloud integration.

tree.name: Electronics and Programming Foundations
tree.description: Learn C/C++, circuits, digital logic, sensors, actuators, debugging, and microcontroller basics.

children.name: C/C++ for Firmware
children.description: Use variables, pointers, structs, memory, interrupts, timing, and hardware-aware code safely.

children.name: Circuits and Sensors
children.description: Understand voltage, current, resistors, breadboards, GPIO, ADC, PWM, I2C, SPI, and UART.

tree.name: Devices and IoT Protocols
tree.description: Build firmware on Arduino, ESP32, or Raspberry Pi Pico and send data over Wi-Fi, BLE, MQTT, and HTTP.

children.name: MQTT and Device Messaging
children.description: Use topics, retained messages, QoS, certificates, device shadows, and telemetry payloads.

children.name: RTOS Basics
children.description: Learn tasks, scheduling, queues, semaphores, timers, and real-time constraints.

children.name: Practice: Sensor Calibration Lab
children.description: Calibrate sensor readings, handle noisy data, add watchdog behavior, and document wiring plus test results.

tree.name: Cloud, Security, and Projects
tree.description: Connect devices to dashboards, secure firmware updates, monitor telemetry, and document hardware projects.

children.name: IoT Security
children.description: Secure keys, firmware, OTA updates, device identity, encrypted transport, and physical attack assumptions.

children.name: Project: Connected Sensor System
children.description: Build a sensor device that publishes data, shows a dashboard, handles offline cases, and includes wiring diagrams.

tree.name: Reliability and Hardware Handoff
tree.description: Move beyond prototypes by testing devices, documenting hardware, and preparing systems for field use.

children.name: PCB and Enclosure Basics
children.description: Translate breadboard prototypes into schematics, simple PCBs, connectors, power protection, and enclosure constraints.

children.name: Field Diagnostics
children.description: Add device logs, health checks, watchdogs, OTA rollback plans, telemetry alerts, and hardware test checklists.
